chunks: They used to hew dwellings in the mountains to live in security.
ai.seo_question: Who carved their homes into the mountains in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (often linked to the people of Thamud in Surah Al-Hijr) illustrates the concept of 'Amn' (security) derived from material strength, which often led to arrogance and eventual divine punishment. The architectural feat of carving homes into mountains is viewed not merely as a technical achievement but as a symbol of their reliance on physical fortifications over spiritual humility, a theme frequently cited by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to discuss the transient nature of worldly security.
